title: Culture of IMR90 Cells
protocol: Remove 50 mL of volume from the bottle of MEM basal medium.
Add 50 mL of fetal bovine serum (FBS) to the remaining volume of MEM.
Add 5 mL of 100X penicillin/streptomycin to the medium.
Add 5 mL of 100X MEM non-essential amino acids (NEAA) to the medium.
Add 5 mL of 100 mM sodium pyruvate to the medium.
Mix thoroughly and label with the date and additives.
Warm medium and prepare materials prior to obtaining a vial of cells from cryostorage.
Remove vial from liquid nitrogen (wearing eye protection).
Thaw vial in 37 °C water bath (1-2 min).
Add 24 mL of growth medium to a 50 mL conical tube.
Transfer thawed cells from the cryovial into the growth medium.
Invert the conical tube gently to mix the cells with the medium.
Pellet cells via centrifugation at 1,000 x g for 4 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the cells in 12 mL of pre-warmed growth medium.
Add 13 mL of additional growth medium to the resuspended cells.
Transfer the cell suspension into a collagen-coated 15 cm dish.
Incubate the dish in a humidified 37°C incubator with 5% CO₂ and 20% O₂ overnight.
Check cells the following day for attachment to the dish.
Replace the medium to remove dead, unattached cells (rounded).
Culture thawed cells for at least three passages before using them in experiments.
Pre-warm growth medium and PBS in a 37°C water bath.
Pre-warm trypsin aliquot at room temperature.
Aspirate the cell culture medium.
Rinse cells with pre-warmed PBS, swirling gently.
Aspirate the PBS wash.
Add trypsin to the plate and rotate evenly.
Incubate the plate in a 37°C incubator for 4 minutes.
Tap the side of the dish to facilitate cell detachment.
Check cell detachment with a microscope if necessary.
Add 12 mL of medium and gently wash the surface of the dish with a pipette, tritrate once.
Transfer the cells to a 50 mL conical tube.
Wash the dish with an additional 12 mL of medium.
Collect the wash and triturate.
Add the collected cells to the existing cell suspension in the conical tube.
Centrifuge at 1,000 x g for 4 minutes to pellet cells.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend in 12 mL of medium.
Triturate at least four times to thoroughly break up clumped cells.
Prepare a 1:1 dilution in Trypan Blue (50 μL Trypan Blue + 50 μL cell suspension).
Count cells that exclude Trypan Blue on a hemocytometer.
Record the number of cells obtained per plate.
Calculate the number of population doublings during the last passage.
Mix thoroughly by inversion and dispense the diluted cell suspension into each dish.
Incubate in a humidified incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2 and 20% O2.
Place bottles of medium and PBS in 5% CO2 incubator with lids partially unscrewed for 15 minutes to adjust pH before returning to 4 °C fridge to store.
Prepare freezing medium by mixing 50% FBS, 40% growth medium, and 10% DMSO.
Filter the freezing medium through a 0.2 μm pore syringe filter.
Determine the number of cells present.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 1,000 x g for 4 minutes at room temperature.

Aliquot cells into cryovials (1 mL per vial).
Place vials in a Mr.Frosty controlled freezing container filled to the indicated line with isopropyl alcohol and place in a -80°C freezer overnight.
Transfer frozen vials to liquid nitrogen storage.
